edge_explainer.market_believes: The safe, disciplined insurer to hide in — bid it near its high in a defensive rotation for the ~20% ROE and the reserve reputation.
edge_explainer.we_believe: Mostly right on quality (the NII/float engine is real, growing, and gets bid in higher-for-longer), the multiple is fundamentally supported (only half TRV's premium, Gordon-fair), and it diversifies the book — but the 'well-reserved' reputation is stale: core casualty is now modestly adverse on social inflation. Own it for the carry at fair value, size against the reserve tail.
edge_explainer.why_we_might_have_edge: The market may be extrapolating TRV-style peak-crowding onto WRB, but WRB's multiple is only ~half as extended vs its own history and is backed by a still-growing NII engine — modest re-rate room if the reserve creep stays contained.
edge_explainer.why_it_might_be_priced_in: Near its 52wk high at fair value with a live reserve-creep flag and decelerating NPW — there is essentially no valuation edge; the return is the carry, and the reserve tail is a real downside.
edge_explainer.what_resolves_it: The Insurance-segment PY development line + AY-ex-cat loss ratio in the next two 10-Qs.
edge_explainer.mechanism_falsifier: Insurance-segment adverse development >$75M/qtr (or >$150M cumulative 2026) or AY-ex-cat loss ratio >64% falsifies 'contained, well-disclosed drag' -> the reserve book is deteriorating -> trim.
